source.source_locator: 教則 第4章 4.4「機体の動力源」(2)1)リチウムポリマーバッテリーの特徴

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 急上昇時の大電流負荷は一時的な電圧降下を生み、残量が減ったように見えることがある。
evidence.tested_misconception: 急負荷後の表示低下を直ちに恒久的容量損失とみなす。
evidence.reasoning_path: high-current climb -> transient voltage sag -> temporary apparent SOC drop

independent_review.rationale: 4.4 explains the apparent post-climb battery drop as transient voltage sag caused by high current; no canonical load-induced voltage-sag item exists.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review is source-consistent, preserves second-class scope, and correctly rejects two sensor-fact candidates whose answer-defining propositions are already represented in released questions. The remaining 28 candidates cover distinct Chapter 4 system characteristics, equipment boundaries, sensor principles, powertrain/battery behavior, and radio propagation with useful commercial practice value.
